followed_sources_checked.notes: Checked Stanford SVL / BEHAVIOR signals for new 2024+ embodied environment and executable-world releases; no new accepted additions this run.
Checked Princeton PVL and Infinigen surfaces for new procedural or simulation-ready world releases; no qualifying new registry addition this run.
Ai2 Embodied AI produced the strongest new qualifying signal this run via MolmoAct2.
Checked NVIDIA Cosmos / Isaac / GR00T surfaces; found recent signals but nothing newly accepted beyond already covered registry items.
Checked REAL lab surfaces; no new qualifying 2024+ addition beyond already captured scene-generation and manipulation lines.
Checked Stanford IRIS / OpenVLA surfaces; no new accepted 2024+ paper beyond existing registry coverage.
Checked Berkeley RAIL / BAIR robotics signals; broad search returned mostly background rather than new primary-source candidates for this repository.
Checked Physical Intelligence signal space; found only indirect search results this run, so no new primary-source-backed addition was accepted.
Checked Google DeepMind robotics signal space; results were either already known or not clean primary-source additions for this run.
Checked UT Austin RPL signal surface via broad search for embodied and scene-generation lines; no new accepted addition emerged.
Checked Meta FAIR embodied signals; nothing newly accepted this run.
LeRobot was relevant as a release signal because the MolmoAct2 official page explicitly announced LeRobot integration.
Checked TRI LBM signal space; no new qualifying addition this run.
Checked MIT CSAIL / Drake scene-generation line; no new accepted paper was identified in the current search window.
World-model benchmark cluster yielded WorldArena 2.0 as a direct accepted addition and GE-Sim 2.0 as an undecided candidate.

candidates.title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
candidates.why_candidate: Open VLA release with official blog, code/data release signal, strong real-robot evidence, and direct relevance to action-model baselines.

candidates.title: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
candidates.why_candidate: Direct benchmark upgrade for embodied world models with official benchmark site and clear relevance to evaluation infrastructure.

candidates.title: Embodied3DBench: Benchmarking Low-Level Embodied Spatial Intelligence of Vision Language Models
candidates.why_candidate: New benchmark for low-level embodied spatial intelligence, grounding, affordance, grasp-point, and trajectory-oriented perception.

candidates.title: ESPIRE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
candidates.why_candidate: Physically grounded generative benchmark for localization and execution, closely aligned with reasoning-to-act evaluation.

candidates.title: GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Potentially strong world-simulator addition, but generation-heavy and likely to require visual/demo inspection before acceptance.

candidates.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
candidates.why_candidate: Large embodied foundation model with open-release and real-robot claims; likely relevant but demo/release confirmation was incomplete.

triage.reason: Primary source plus official Ai2 release page; high impact and direct VLA baseline relevance.
Primary benchmark paper plus official public benchmark site; clear infrastructure fit.
New embodied spatial benchmark with explicit low-level task coverage and strong project relevance.
Physically grounded spatial benchmark with localization plus execution framing; high diagnostic value.
Potentially high-value world-simulator paper, but demo quality likely needs human confirmation.
Potentially strong embodied foundation model with real-robot relevance, but release/demo confirmation is incomplete.
